foreground.prompt: Extract prominent purple chromatin chains at the same scale and positions into true transparent RGBA. Remove grey fluid and distant particles; open the central third for a fixed zoom corridor. Keep sharp lighting/material detail, no blur or text.

background.prompt: Outpaint a3x wider square field: supplied nucleosome/DNA scene in central third at one-third pixel size, more irregular connected chains outside. Match neutral grey fluid, beige/lavender materials and lighting. No purple foreground chains, text, inset, or baked blur.

assembly: Finished level-4 is downsampled into the central third of background-raw; foreground is composited over it. The exact stacked result is level-3, propagated to all larger parents. All are sharp. Existing finer levels are retained.
rendering: 2.5D optical planes, not a molecular-coordinate simulation. Foreground remains opaque, zooms faster and gains app blur only after replacement. Rear plane slows and defocuses. Fixed zoom axis.
scale_status: Existing illustrative nucleosome11nm/DNA2nm conventions retained; generated molecular geometry is approximate.
